mods.name: CraftFromChests
mods.description: Crafting stations use materials from nearby chests. Buttons beside the crafting tabs show lines to the chests in use and cycle the range (5-30 m).
mods.notes: Chest-lines and range buttons beside the crafting tabs; reload-safe for hot reloading.

mods.name: ModUpdater
mods.description: This mod manager (F7). Updates itself like any other mod.
mods.notes: New look: opaque window, mod cards with status badges, tidier player table. Turn mods on/off, Reload and Open-folder buttons, update notes, chat notice when updates are waiting, window stays open across reloads. Fixes the refresh crash. Developer Mode now asks before replacing your own build.
